text: सीता रामकी दिदी हुन्। त्यसो भए राम सीताका को हुन्?
gloss: Sita is Ram's elder sister (दिदी). So what is Ram to Sita? — भाइ (younger brother): Nepali marks age in sibling words, so the autopilot answer दाइ (elder brother) is wrong.

text: पसलेले ‘अढाई सय रुपैयाँ’ भन्यो भने तपाईंले कति रुपैयाँ तिर्नुपर्छ?
gloss: The shopkeeper says 'adhai say rupees'. How much do you pay? — 250: अढाई means two and a half, so two and a half hundred.

text: साथीले ‘आउ, चिया-सिया खाऔँ’ भन्दा ‘सिया’ ले के जनाउँछ?
gloss: A friend says 'come, let's have chiya-siya'. What does 'siya' add? — Tea and the like: an echo word that repeats the noun with a new first sound to mean 'and such things'.

text: थर्मसले तातो चियालाई तातै राख्छ। त्यही थर्मसमा बरफको पानी राखे केही घण्टापछि त्यो कस्तो हुन्छ?
gloss: A flask keeps hot tea hot. Put ice water in it: after a few hours it is? — Still cold: the flask only slows heat moving in either direction.

text: तिहारको कुन दिन कुकुरलाई माला लगाएर पूजा गरिन्छ?
gloss: On which day of Tihar are dogs garlanded and worshipped? — The second day (Kukur Tihar); day one is for crows, day three for cows and Laxmi, day five Bhai Tika.

text: माटोको कटौरामा जमाइने ‘जुजु धौ’ कुन सहरको चिनारी हो?
gloss: Juju dhau, curd set in clay bowls, is the hallmark of which town? — Bhaktapur: 'king of curds' in Newari.

text: फेवाताल र त्यसमा देखिने माछापुच्छ्रेको छायाका लागि चर्चित सहर कुन हो?
gloss: Which city is famous for Phewa Lake and Machhapuchhre reflected in it? — Pokhara.

text: गन्धर्वहरूले गाउँदै बजाउने सारङ्गी कसरी बजाइन्छ?
gloss: How is the sarangi, played by Gandharva singers, played? — By bowing (रेटेर): it is a bowed string instrument.

text: उखान पूरा गर्नुहोस्: ‘जस्तो देश, उस्तै …’
gloss: Complete the proverb 'As the country, so the ...' — भेष (dress): 'when in Rome, do as the Romans do'.

text: छठ पर्वमा व्रतालुहरू पानीमा उभिएर कसलाई अर्घ्य दिन्छन्?
gloss: During Chhath, devotees stand in water and make offerings to whom? — The Sun (Surya), at sunset and sunrise.

text: पशुपतिनाथ मन्दिर र आर्यघाट कुन नदीको किनारमा छन्?
gloss: Pashupatinath temple and Arya Ghat stand on which river? — The Bagmati.

text: नेपालको उत्तरी सीमामा छिमेकी चीनको कुन स्वायत्त क्षेत्र पर्छ?
gloss: Which autonomous region of China lies along Nepal's northern border? — Tibet (Yunnan is a province, not on the border).

text: बौद्ध देवदेवीका चित्र कोरिएको थाङ्का प्रायः केमा बनाइन्छ?
gloss: A thangka with Buddhist deities is usually painted on what? — Cloth (cotton canvas), so it can be rolled up.

text: बैंकले मोबाइलमा पठाएको ओटीपी कसैलाई भन्नु हुँदैन। ओटीपी के हो?
options: एक पटक मात्र चल्ने गोप्य कोड
gloss: Never tell anyone the OTP your bank texts you. What is an OTP? — A one-time password: a secret code valid once.

text: पसलमा टाँसिएको क्युआर कोड मोबाइल एपले स्क्यान गरेर प्रायः के गरिन्छ?
gloss: What do people usually do by scanning the QR code stuck up in a shop? — Pay.

text: फुटबलमा गोलकिपरबाहेकका खेलाडीले बल हातले समातेर फाल्न पाउने अवस्था कुन हो?
gloss: In football, when may an outfield player pick up the ball and throw it? — The throw-in.

text: पिज्जामा तानिने गरी पग्लिने मोजरेला चिज मूलतः कुन देशको हो?
gloss: Mozzarella, the cheese that stretches on pizza, comes originally from which country? — Italy (Campania).

text: फ्रिजमा राखेको दूध छिटो नबिग्रनुको मुख्य कारण के हो?
gloss: Why does milk in the fridge keep longer? — Bacteria multiply slowly in the cold.

text: राष्ट्रिय फूल लालीगुराँस पहाडमा कुन ऋतुमा फुल्छ?
gloss: In which season does the rhododendron (laligurans), Nepal's national flower, bloom in the hills? — Spring (roughly Phagun to Baisakh).

text: गर्मीमा कुकुर जिब्रो निकालेर हस्याङफस्याङ गर्छ। किन?
gloss: In summer a dog pants with its tongue out. Why? — To cool down: dogs barely sweat, so they lose heat by panting.

text: पहेँला, चस्मा लगाउने साना ‘मिनियन्स’ कुन फिल्म शृङ्खलाका पात्र हुन्?
gloss: The little yellow goggled 'Minions' come from which film series? — Despicable Me.

text: सामान्य रुबिक्स क्युबको हरेक मोहडामा ३×३ रङ्गीन वर्ग हुन्छन्। पूरै क्युबमा जम्मा कति वर्ग देखिन्छन्?
gloss: A standard Rubik's cube has 3×3 coloured squares on each face. How many in all? — 54: six faces × nine (27 is the trap: the number of small cubes).

text: धेरै नेपाली कामदार रहेको कतारको राजधानी कुन हो?
gloss: What is the capital of Qatar, where many Nepali workers live? — Doha (Riyadh is Saudi Arabia's, Muscat Oman's; Dubai is a UAE city).

text: धेरै शिवालयमा मूल ढोकातिर फर्केर बसेको साँढेको मूर्ति हुन्छ। शिवको यो वाहनको नाम के हो?
gloss: Many Shiva temples have a bull statue facing the shrine. What is the name of Shiva's mount? — Nandi (Garuda is Vishnu's, Airavata Indra's).

text: अर्केस्ट्राको अगाडि उभिएर सानो छडी हल्लाउँदै बजाउनेहरूलाई निर्देशन दिने व्यक्तिलाई के भनिन्छ?
gloss: The person who stands in front of an orchestra waving a baton to direct it is the? — Conductor.

text: क्रिकेटको ‘एलबीडब्ल्यू’ आउटमा ‘एल’ कुन अङ्ग्रेजी शब्दबाट आएको हो?
gloss: In cricket's LBW, what English word is the L? — Leg (leg before wicket).

text: नेपालका मोबाइल नम्बर सामान्यतया कुन अङ्कबाट सुरु हुन्छन्?
gloss: Nepali mobile numbers usually start with which digit? — 9 (98…, 97…, 96…).

text: भान्सामा ग्यास चुहिएको गन्ध आयो भने तुरुन्तै के गर्नु हुँदैन?
gloss: If you smell leaking gas in the kitchen, what must you not do? — Flip an electric switch: the spark can ignite the gas. The rest are what you should do.

text: गौतम बुद्धको जन्मस्थल लुम्बिनी कुन जिल्लामा पर्छ?
gloss: Lumbini, the Buddha's birthplace, is in which district? — Rupandehi (Kapilvastu, the trap, is next door).

text: चाकु वा खुवा भरेर माछाको आकारमा बनाइने ‘योमरी’ मूलतः कुन समुदायको परिकार हो?
gloss: Yomari, the rice-flour dumpling filled with chaku or khuwa, is originally a dish of which community? — The Newars (eaten at Yomari Punhi).

text: ‘पोहोर साल’ भन्नाले कुन वर्ष बुझिन्छ?
gloss: What does 'pohor sal' mean? — Last year (two years ago is परार).

text: ‘दशमी’ दसौँ तिथि हो। त्यसो भए ‘द्वादशी’ कुन तिथि हो?
gloss: 'Dashami' is the tenth lunar day. So which is 'dwadashi'? — The twelfth: द्वि (two) + दश (ten). 'Second' is the trap.

text: गर्मीमा चिसो पानीको गिलासको बाहिरपट्टि पानीका थोपा देखिन्छन्। ती कहाँबाट आउँछन्?
gloss: Drops form on the outside of a glass of cold water in summer. Where from? — Water vapour in the air condensing on the cold glass.

text: हात्तीका लामा सेता हस्तिदन्त वास्तवमा के हुन्?
gloss: What are an elephant's long white tusks really? — Teeth (overgrown incisors).

text: सुयोग र सकम्बरीको कथा भएको उपन्यास ‘शिरीषको फूल’ कसले लेखेकी हुन्?
gloss: Who wrote the novel 'Shirishko Phool', the story of Suyogbir and Sakambari? — Parijat (Madan Puraskar 1965).

text: फिल्मका जासुस जेम्स बन्डको गोप्य कोड नम्बर कति हो?
gloss: What is the secret code number of film spy James Bond? — 007.

text: वेबसाइटको ठेगानामा ‘एचटीटीपीएस’ को अन्तिम ‘एस’ ले के जनाउँछ?
gloss: What does the final 'S' in HTTPS stand for? — Secure: the connection is encrypted.

text: टेनिसको अङ्क गणनामा शून्यलाई के भनिन्छ?
gloss: In tennis scoring, what is zero called? — Love.

text: बौद्धनाथ स्तूपको गजुरमुनि चारैतिर के कोरिएको छ?
gloss: What is painted on all four sides below the spire of Boudhanath stupa? — The Buddha's eyes.

text: बिजुलीको शक्ति भएको पहेँलो मुसाजस्तो चर्चित पोकेमोनको नाम के हो?
gloss: What is the famous yellow, mouse-like electric Pokémon called? — Pikachu.

text: रामायणकी सीताको जन्मभूमि मानिने, जानकी मन्दिर भएको सहर कुन हो?
gloss: Which city, home of the Janaki temple, is held to be the birthplace of Sita? — Janakpur.

text: पानी परेपछि इन्द्रेणी देख्न घाम कतातिर हुनुपर्छ?
gloss: After rain, where must the sun be for you to see a rainbow? — Behind you: the drops in front of you send the sunlight back.

text: नेपालमा सती प्रथा कानुनी रूपमा अन्त्य गर्ने राणा प्रधानमन्त्री को हुन्?
gloss: Which Rana prime minister legally abolished sati in Nepal? — Chandra Shumsher (1920); Jung Bahadur had only restricted it.

text: जापानी सुसीमा कुन कुरा अनिवार्य हुन्छ?
gloss: What is the one essential ingredient of Japanese sushi? — Vinegared rice; raw fish, seaweed and soy are common but optional.

text: सूर्यको प्रकाश पृथ्वीसम्म आइपुग्न करिब ८ मिनेट लाग्छ। सूर्य अहिले नै निभ्यो भने हामीले कहिले थाहा पाउँछौँ?
gloss: Sunlight takes about 8 minutes to reach Earth. If the Sun went out now, when would we know? — After about 8 minutes: the last light already on its way keeps arriving.

text: बोस्फोरस जलडमरूमध्यले छुट्याएको इस्तानबुल सहर कुन दुई महादेशमा फैलिएको छ?
gloss: Istanbul, split by the Bosphorus, spreads over which two continents? — Europe and Asia.

text: ‘काठमाडौँ’ सहरको नाम कुन संरचनाको नामबाट आएको मानिन्छ?
gloss: The name Kathmandu is held to come from which structure? — Kasthamandap, the wooden pavilion ('wood mandap').

text: पृथ्वीमा ६० किलो पिण्ड भएको अन्तरिक्षयात्री चन्द्रमामा पुग्दा उसको पिण्ड कति हुन्छ?
gloss: An astronaut of 60 kg mass on Earth lands on the Moon: what is their mass? — The same as on Earth: mass does not change, only weight (about 1/6). 'A sixth' is the autopilot trap.

text: जङ्गबहादुरको समयको कथा भन्ने ऐतिहासिक उपन्यास ‘सेतो बाघ’ का लेखक को हुन्?
gloss: Who wrote 'Seto Bagh', the historical novel set in Jung Bahadur's time? — Diamond Shumsher Rana.

text: हेलियम ग्यास पृथ्वीमा भेटिनुअघि नै पहिलो पटक कहाँ पत्ता लागेको थियो?
gloss: Before it was found on Earth, where was helium first detected? — In the spectrum of sunlight (1868 eclipse, Janssen and Lockyer); named after Helios.
